name: mcp-mysql-database
description: Servidor MCP para MySQL: conecta Claude con bases de datos MySQL locales (Docker) en lenguaje natural

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && rm -rf .mcpb-build && mkdir .mcpb-build && cp -R dist package.json package-lock.json manifest.json LICENSE .mcpb-build/ && npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --prefix .mcpb-build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack .mcpb-build mysql.mcpb && rm -rf .mcpb-build
